description: Kraken public Trades for XBTUSD, rebucketed to 1-minute last-price/volume/count bars -- an additional liquid-market cross-check series alongside schema/external_crypto_klines.json's Binance/bitbank feeds.
source: Kraken public REST, no auth: GET https://api.kraken.com/0/public/Trades?pair=XBTUSD (paged forward via the response's nanosecond `last` cursor) -- see scripts/fetch_kraken.py.
retention: appended forward, merged with existing history on every fetch run (never truncated).

price.meaning: last trade price in the bin

volume.meaning: summed trade size in the bin

known_defects: scripts/fetch_kraken.py runs under a wall-clock time budget (--max-seconds) and stops early, saving whatever it has, if paging can't catch up to now within that budget -- a run can therefore leave the file short of the present without raising an error
